## Codex execution contract

**CGS-16 review and evidence contract:** Treat task APIs and hooks as optional; when unavailable, report that limit and do not claim they ran. Preserve previous user authorization and the current host permissions. Read the target and relevant registered facts; use the actual per-system workflow tier, distinguish required sections and measurable criteria, and cite concrete lines. When required adversarial roles cannot be independently invoked disclose the in-session fallback and keep incomplete gate coverage NOT ASSESSED; do not label it independent or approve missing evidence. Findings and recommendations do not authorize editing the GDD or tracking records.
